notes:
Messages are created more reliably: the automatic check sometimes contradicted
itself, wrote new mistakes into its own corrections and in the end produced no
message at all. Now an objection only counts if it quotes a concrete passage of
the message. If an objection remains, the message is still created and flagged
in the review so you can decide. Dashes are removed automatically.

Posts are only used if they are at most 6 months old. If a post is older or its
age cannot be read, the message relies on the profile and experience instead of
outdated content.
